title: Run no more gaming machines than the licence fixes
what: A venue's gaming machine licence fixes the number of machines it may run, which may not exceed the maximum prescribed for its category of premises.

sources.title: Gaming Machine Act 1991 (Qld)
sources.quote: (4) If the gaming machine licence is to relate to single premises only, the number of gaming machines fixed must not be greater than— (a) the number sought in the application; or (b) the maximum number prescribed under a regulation for the category of licensed premises to which the premises will belong.

sources.title: Gaming Machine Act 1991 (Qld)
sources.locator: s 460, words naming the body (found 18 Nov 2026) (current)
sources.quote: commission means the Queensland Liquor and Gaming Commission established under the former Act.

assessment.summary: A gaming machine licence fixes how many machines a venue may run, never more than the maximum prescribed for its category of premises. A cap on numbers for each hotel and club, set for harm minimisation.

marks.reason: Caps how many gaming machines each venue may run.
